reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that experience functions as both a direct causal agent and a cumulative force shaping cognition. In GSI, this manifests as a Bayesian update mechanism where each new sensory datum modifies posterior beliefs about mental models. The temporal and spatial conjunctions of experience define the structure of these beliefs, forming a coherent logical framework. In GSE, the same principle governs state transitions—each experience modifies the system's internal representation of possible future states. The dual nature of experience as both immediate educator and inherited kernel creates a recursive loop in cognitive development. Failure modes arise when experience is too sparse or inconsistent, leading to unstable or divergent mental models. The mathematical formalism treats experience as a structured input that modulates belief distributions and state transitions through a hierarchy of temporal and spatial constraints.
